title: ERICA
text: ERICA, or Hearth, in benny, a genus of the other- dirina nonogona clade. The calise conflict of four leaves, and the corolla of four fragments; the filaments are infected into the receptacle; the anthem are bid; and the copilole has four cells. Three thirty eight-species, one of which are native of Britain, viz. the vulgaris, or common health; the cinerers, or fine-leaved hearts; the retraix, or crofs-leaved heads; the cilla- ray, or rough leaved heat; and the multidots, or fir- leaved heart.
